questions.q: At a camp safety drill, one camper handed a lantern from the first person to the last; another lit a stove after the group had settled. Which pair describes the actions?
o: lit the lantern / passed the stove
passed the lantern / lit the stove
wrapped the lantern / tied the stove
tied the lantern / wrapped the stove

exp.trans: 营地安全演练中，一名露营者把灯笼从队伍第一个人传到最后一个人；另一人等大家安顿后点燃了炉子。动作分别是传递灯笼和点燃炉子。
exp.structure: one camper handed a lantern...是第一项动作；from the first person to the last给出传递路径。another lit a stove是第二项动作，after从句说明时间。
exp.other: camp safety drill营地安全演练；lantern灯笼；stove炉子；settle安顿下来。
exp.meaning: pass表示把物品从一个人交给另一个人；light表示点燃。要把动词与其实际宾语及动作路径配对。
exp.rest: 把lit和passed的对象对调；wrap和tie表示包裹/系绑，不符合手递手传灯笼或点燃炉子的动作。

questions.skill: 上限与必须达到的时长
questions.q: Residents may borrow a portable generator for up to ten days; they can return it earlier. What does up to ten days mean?
o: Ten days is the maximum period, not a required stay.
Every borrower must keep it for exactly ten days.
Borrowers may keep it for more than ten days.
The generator can only be used on the tenth day.

exp.trans: 居民最多可以借用便携式发电机十天，也可以提前归还。up to ten days表示最长十天。
exp.structure: may borrow表达许可；for up to ten days限定允许借用的最长时长；they can return it earlier进一步说明不要求用满十天。
exp.other: portable便携式；generator发电机；maximum最大值；earlier更早地。
exp.meaning: up to + 数量/时长表示上限，不表示必须达到该数量或持续完整时段。
exp.rest: exactly ten days把上限改成固定时长；more than ten days超过了明示上限；only on the tenth day把持续时间误解成某一天的使用许可。

questions.target: point / there is no point in doing
questions.q:
With the last bus already gone, there was no point in waiting at the stop.
point 在这里最接近：
o: 联合会
尖端
分数
用处

exp.trans: 末班车已经开走了，继续在车站等也没有意义。
exp.structure: 主干：there was no point in waiting at the stop，是there be存在句。With the last bus already gone补充原因背景。简单句The last bus was already gone → 去掉was，用with + 名词 + 状态补语压缩。
exp.other: last bus 末班车；already 已经；be gone 已经离开、不在了；bus stop 公交站。
exp.meaning: there is no point in doing sth：做某事没有意义；point不是物理位置上的点。
exp.rest: 联合会常用federation/association，与句意无关。尖端可用the point of a needle，必须是具体物体的尖端。分数可说score three points，但这里不是计分语境。

questions.target: with + 名词 + 后置成分
questions.skill: with + 名词 + 后置修饰
questions.q: The audience waited quietly, with the lights gradually dimming before the film began. The with-structure mainly:
o: adds a simultaneous background state
states the purpose of waiting
introduces an independent main clause
means the audience waited together with the lights

exp.trans: 观众安静地等待着，电影开始前，灯光正逐渐变暗。
exp.structure: 主干：The audience（主语）+ waited（谓语）+ quietly（状语）。原始简单句：The lights were gradually dimming before the film began. → 去掉were，用with引出：with the lights gradually dimming...。the lights是with结构的逻辑主语，dimming与lights构成主动关系。
exp.other: audience 观众；gradually 逐渐地；dim 变暗；before the film began 电影开始前。
exp.meaning: with + 名词 + 后置成分可补充主句发生时的伴随状态或背景。
exp.rest: 目的通常用to do/in order to；with结构不是新的独立主句；这里with不是“和灯光一起”等普通介词伴随对象，而是带逻辑主语和分词的复合结构。

questions.target: 共同动词支配 / 并列任务
questions.q: The inspector recommended replacing the worn belt and checking the tension before restarting the machine. Which reading preserves the recommendation?
o: The inspector reported that both jobs had already been completed.
Replacing the belt was expected to check the tension automatically.
The inspector recommended two tasks: belt replacement and a tension check.
The machine should be restarted before either task is attempted.

exp.trans: 检查员建议在重新启动机器之前更换磨损的皮带并检查张力。建议包含两项任务：更换皮带和检查张力，而不是报告它们已经完成。
exp.structure: The inspector是主语，recommended是谓语。replacing the worn belt与checking the tension是并列动名词短语，共同作recommended的补足内容；before restarting the machine给执行顺序。
exp.other: inspector 检查员；worn belt 磨损的皮带；tension 张力；restart 重新启动。
exp.meaning: and把两项动作放在同一层级，都受recommended支配。后一个动名词不是第一个动作自动产生的效果，也不是新的已完成事实。
exp.rest: had already been completed把建议改成过去已完成事实；check ... automatically把两项独立任务合成一项的自动效果；restarted before either task反转before给出的执行顺序。

questions.target: 局部总结 / 段尾钩子
questions.q: A paragraph says: “Taken together, the short trials show that the sensor detects small leaks. That finding raises a further question: can it operate for weeks without a battery change?” Which next paragraph would best develop the hook?
o: A report of a month-long run and its power use.
A repetition of the first trial’s one-hour detection rate.
A history of the material used in the first sensor.
A claim that accurate detection already proves long battery life.

exp.trans: 一段写道：“短期试验合起来表明传感器能检测到小泄漏。这个发现引出进一步的问题：不换电池，它能否运行数周？”最能展开段尾钩子的是长达一个月的运行和耗电报告。
exp.structure: Taken together概括short trials；the sensor + detects + small leaks是that宾语从句。That finding回指检测结果。can it operate...?的问题将检测能力推进到长期供电能力。
exp.other: trial 试验；leak 泄漏；operate 运转；power use 耗电量。
exp.meaning: 局部总结不是全文封口。选下一段要回应新的运行时长问题，而非机械重复已总结的检测准确性。
exp.rest: one-hour detection rate只重复旧测试，未回答数周运行；material history转去材料背景，未接耗电问题；accurate detection proves long battery life把检测能力当成续航证据，两项指标不能自动互证。

questions.skill: 避免把可能风险扩大成已经发生的事实
questions.q: A mountain road report says heavy snow can lead to closures, but today's bulletin only forecasts snow. Which conclusion is supported?
o: The road is closed today because heavy snow is forecast.
The forecast identifies a risk, not a confirmed closure today.
The road has remained open through every previous snowstorm.
The report proves that snow will not affect road access today.

exp.trans: 山区道路报告说，大雪可能导致封路，但今天的公告只是在预报降雪。最有根据的结论是：预报指出一种风险，并没有确认今天已经封路。
exp.structure: can lead to closures表达可能结果；today's bulletin only forecasts snow限制了当前已知事实。题干要求判断能得出什么结论，而不是推断可能后果已经发生。
exp.other: forecast 预报；closure 封路；confirmed 已确认的；road access 道路通行。
exp.meaning: 不能把条件性风险升级为已发生事件。可能导致封路，不等于今天已经封路；同样也不能反向断言降雪一定不会影响通行。
exp.rest: 预报降雪不等于已经封路；没有证据说明道路经历过所有以往的雪暴；报告指出风险，并没有证明雪不会影响通行。

questions.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
questions.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
questions.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

action-collocation.q: During a field inspection, a technician fastened a thin cord around the sensor housing by making a knot. The team then handed a calibration weight from one person to the next. Which pair describes the actions?
o: wrapped the cord / carried the weight
tied the cord / passed the weight
passed the cord / tied the weight
lit the cord / wrapped the weight

exp.trans: 现场检查时，技术员打结把细绳系在传感器外壳上；随后团队成员把校准砝码从一人手中传到下一人手中。对应动作是tie和pass。
exp.structure: 第一句technician fastened...by making a knot，by短语明确系绳方式是打结；第二句the team handed...from one person to the next，明确物体在人与人之间转交。
exp.other: field inspection现场检查；sensor housing传感器外壳；calibration weight校准砝码；knot结。
exp.meaning: tie表示系住、打结；pass something from one person to the next表示把东西传递给下一个人。要识别动作的结果和路径。
exp.rest: wrap表示包裹或缠绕，未必形成固定的结；carry表示携带而非交到下一人手中；pass the cord / tie the weight把两个动作对象对调；light和wrap都不符合句中动作。

action-collocation.skill: 包裹与打结的动作区别
action-collocation.q: Before shipping a glass instrument, a clerk covered it with protective cloth, folding the cloth around the case in several layers. No knot or fastening was used. Which paraphrase best describes the action?
o: wrapped the case in protective cloth
tied the cloth tightly around the case
passed the cloth to a colleague nearby
lit the cloth with a match

exp.trans: 发运玻璃仪器前，工作人员用防护布包住仪器，把布一层层折叠在外壳周围；没有打结或固定。动作是包裹。
exp.structure: a clerk covered it...是主干；folding the cloth around the case补充包裹方式；No knot or fastening was used排除了打结固定。
exp.other: protective cloth防护布；case外壳；layer层；fastening固定件/固定动作。
exp.meaning: wrap强调用材料包住或缠绕物体；tie强调用绳带系住，常包含打结或固定。此处布料覆盖并折叠，没有系结。
exp.rest: tie要求系住/固定的动作，题干明确说没有knot或fastening；pass表示传递；light表示点燃，均不符合包裹仪器的场景。

logic.q: The medicine must stay below 8°C; it may lose effectiveness ___ it is kept in a refrigerator during transport.
o: because
unless
although
so that

exp.trans: 这种药必须保持在8摄氏度以下；运输途中如果不放在冰箱里，它可能会失去药效。
exp.structure: 分号前：The medicine（主语）+ must stay（谓语）+ below 8°C（补足信息）。分号后主干：it（主语）+ may lose（谓语）+ effectiveness（宾语）。unless引导条件状语从句：it is kept in a refrigerator during transport，相当于 if it is not kept...。
exp.other: effectiveness 有效性；refrigerator 冰箱；during transport 在运输过程中；keep sth below... 使某物保持在……以下。
exp.meaning: unless = if...not，表示“除非/如果不”。这里逻辑是：不冷藏 → 可能失效。
exp.rest: because表示原因，会变成“因为被冷藏所以失效”，逻辑相反；although表示让步，不能表达必要条件；so that表示目的/结果，通常是“为了……”，与这里的风险条件不符。

logic.q: The sensor readings are useful for tracking daily changes. ___, they are too imprecise to determine whether a bridge meets the safety limit. Which connector best links the two assessments?
o: For example
However
Similarly
Therefore

exp.trans: 这些传感器读数有助于追踪每日变化；然而，读数还不够精确，无法判断桥梁是否达到安全限值。
exp.structure: 首句主语The sensor readings，系表结构are useful；第二句they回指读数，too imprecise to determine说明精度限制。
exp.other: reading 读数；imprecise 不精确的；meet a limit 达到界限要求。
exp.meaning: 共同话题并不等于并列关系。第一句肯定一种用途，第二句限制另一种用途，因此用转折引出限定。
exp.rest: “例如”不能把不适用的用途当成前句有用的实例；“同样”忽略由肯定到限制的变化；“因此”错误地把精度不足说成有用的必然结果。

logic.q: The archivist kept the fragile maps in a sealed cabinet ___ humidity fell below the safe limit, ___ the digitization team continued scanning copies in the next room. Choose the best pair.
o: until / whereas
whereas / until
although / because
because / although

exp.trans: 湿度降到安全范围以下之前，档案管理员一直把易损地图放在密封柜里；与此同时，数字化团队则在隔壁继续扫描副本。
exp.structure: 第一空连接kept...与humidity fell，表示保存状态持续到某个时间点；第二空连接两组同时发生但不同的安排，表示对比。
exp.other: archivist档案管理员；fragile易损的；sealed密封的；digitization数字化。
exp.meaning: until表示直到某个时间点为止；whereas表示而/然而，用于对照两个主体或情况。时间终点不能用对比连词替代。
exp.rest: whereas不能表达第一分句持续到湿度下降这一时间终点；until不适合第二空的两种安排对比；although表示让步，because表示原因，都不符合两处关系。

point.q: The committee spent twenty minutes arguing about the font on the warning sign, while the real issue was whether the bridge was safe. They were clearly ___.
o: missing the point
making a point
reaching the point
pointing out

diag.1: make a point 常表示“提出观点/特意强调”，这里强调的是没抓住真正问题。
diag.2: reach the point 需要具体语境，如 reach the point where...，不能表达“没抓住重点”。
diag.3: point out 通常后接宾语，表示“指出”；这里既不合结构也不合语义。

exp.trans: 委员会花了二十分钟争论警示牌的字体，而真正的问题是这座桥是否安全。他们显然没有抓住重点。
exp.structure: 第一句：The committee（主语）+ spent（谓语）+ twenty minutes（宾语）；arguing...说明时间花在何事上。while连接对比；whether the bridge was safe作表语从句。第二句：They（主语）+ were missing（现在进行时谓语）+ the point（宾语）。
exp.other: committee 委员会；warning sign 警示牌；issue 问题/争议点；safe 安全的。
exp.meaning: miss the point = 没抓住重点、没理解关键。point 在这里是“要点/关键”，不是“节点”。
exp.rest: make a point = 提出/强调观点；reach the point = 达到某个阶段/程度；point out = 指出某事。只有 missing the point（没抓住重点）符合他们纠结字体却忽视桥梁安全的语境。

point.q:
Even after I explained the joke twice, my brother still missed the point.
missed the point 在这里表示什么？
o: 仍然怀念以前的笑话
仍然没明白笑话的关键
忘记了一个标点符号
没赶上兄弟聚会

exp.trans: 即使我把这个笑话解释了两遍，我弟弟仍然没有明白其中的关键。
exp.structure: 主句：my brother（主语）+ missed（谓语）+ the point（宾语）。after从句：I + explained + the joke；twice修饰explained。even强调即便已经解释过，结果仍如此。
exp.other: joke 笑话；twice 两次；still 仍然；explain 解释。
exp.meaning: miss the point整体表示没领会关键、没明白意思，不能把miss机械地译成怀念。
exp.rest: miss sb可表示想念某人，但miss the point不是这一义项。标点符号一般是punctuation mark，不是这里的point。miss a meeting可表示错过聚会，但原句没有meeting；brother是主语，不是被错过的活动。

point.q: “Residents have a point: the evening bus reaches the station after the last train has left.” What does have a point convey?
o: 居民的意见有道理，时刻表提供了理由。
居民已经同意公交运营方的安排。
公交晚到导致火车晚点。
居民指出了一个新的候车地点。

exp.trans: “居民说得有道理：晚班公交抵达车站时，末班火车已经离开了。”问题问have a point表达什么。
exp.structure: Residents是主语，have是谓语，a point是宾语。冒号后的the evening bus + reaches + the station给出理由；after从句的has left表示火车先已离开。
exp.other: resident 居民；station 车站；the last train 末班火车；timetable 时刻表。
exp.meaning: have a point表示某人的意见有道理或值得考虑。这里肯定的是意见所据的理由，不是找到一个地点；与miss the point不同，这次是抓到了有效理由。
exp.rest: “同意运营方”加入了原文没有的立场，且解释的是时刻衔接不便。“导致火车晚点”倒置了时间信息：火车已走，并未晚点。“新的候车地点”把抽象的意见或道理误当具体地点。

with.skill: 识别with复合结构的伴随状态
with.q: The archive reopened at noon, with several boxes waiting in the loading area. What does the with-clause do?
o: It describes a state accompanying the archive's reopening.
It gives the sole reason the archive reopened at noon.
It reports an action that archive staff carried out.
It is the direct object of reopened in the main clause.

exp.trans: 档案馆中午重新开放，当时有几个箱子正等在装卸区。with结构补充了重新开放时伴随的状态。
exp.structure: 主干是The archive reopened at noon；with several boxes waiting in the loading area是with + 名词 + 现在分词结构，several boxes是waiting的逻辑主语。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；reopen 重新开放；loading area 装卸区；accompany 伴随。
exp.meaning: with复合结构常补充主句发生时的伴随状态。它不是reopened的直接宾语，也不自动表达原因或目的。
exp.rest: 句子没有说明这是档案馆重新开放的唯一原因；with短语描述箱子所处的状态，并未说工作人员另做了一项动作；reopened在这里是不及物动词，不需要直接宾语。

parallel-governance.q: Which sentence has a clean parallel structure in which the same modal verb governs both alternatives?
o: The technician can either replace the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician either can replace the sensor or recalibration of the device.
The technician can either replacing the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician can either replace the sensor or the device is recalibrated.

exp.trans: 正确句：技术员可以要么更换传感器，要么重新校准设备。
exp.structure: 主干：The technician（主语）+ can（情态动词）+ either replace... or recalibrate...。can同时支配replace和recalibrate，两边都是动词原形，结构完全平行。
exp.other: technician 技术员；sensor 传感器；recalibrate 重新校准；device 设备。
exp.meaning: 共同动词支配时，并列两端应保持同一语法层级。这里 can + replace / recalibrate。
exp.rest: either can replace... or recalibration... 把动词结构和名词结构并列；can either replacing... 中情态动词后不能接-ing形式；replace... or the device is recalibrated 把动词短语和完整从句并列，层级不一致。

parallel-governance.q: The redesign owes its success not to a faster motor but to a simpler control panel. Which reading keeps the shared relation intact?
o: The faster motor owes its success to the control panel.
Success is credited to the panel rather than to the motor.
The simpler panel was made possible by the redesign's earlier success.
The sentence credits the motor and the panel equally.

exp.trans: 这次重新设计的成功不是由于更快的电机，而是由于更简单的控制面板。两个to短语共同说明同一个成功应归因于什么。
exp.structure: The redesign是主语，owes是谓语，its success是宾语。not to a faster motor和but to a simpler control panel是同层并列的归因补足语，都受owes its success支配。
exp.other: redesign 重新设计；owe A to B 把A归因于B；motor 电机；control panel 控制面板。
exp.meaning: 共享的是owe success to...的归因结构，不是让后半句生成新主语或改变成功的所属对象。not...but...排除电机、强调面板。
exp.rest: The faster motor owes...把电机改成主语并换掉success所属对象；panel was made possible...把面板作为成功的结果，反转因果；equally忽略not对电机解释的排除。

summary-location.q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It announces the final conclusion of the entire article.
It sums up the first phase before further cost analysis.
It introduces an example unrelated to the first phase.
It signals doubt about the first phase's reported results.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 后文还要分析成本，不能判为全文终结；这句话概括第一阶段而非引入无关例子；Overall本身不表示对结果存疑。

summary-location.target: 总结范围 / 后续核验
summary-location.q: After presenting a commuter survey, a paragraph says: “To sum up, the new schedule suits many commuters. The council will review it after winter, when school travel patterns change.” What do these lines support?
o: The winter review has already overturned the survey findings.
The council has changed the discussion to the cost of new buses.
The paragraph summarises current findings and identifies a later check.
The survey has measured how school journeys changed during the coming winter.

exp.trans: 在呈现通勤调查后，一段写道：“总的说来，新时刻表适合许多通勤者。委员会将在冬季之后重新评估它，届时学生出行规律会变化。”这些句子总结当前发现，并提出之后的核验。
exp.structure: To sum up引入对已给调查的概括。The new schedule + suits + many commuters。The council + will review + it表达将来的评估；when从句补充冬后出行规律变化。
exp.other: commuter 通勤者；schedule 时刻表；review 重新评估；travel pattern 出行规律。
exp.meaning: 总结当前部分与计划未来检查可以同段共存；未来检查还未发生。单靠总结词或后续计划，不能保证这一段必为全文末段或必有下一段。
exp.rest: already overturned把未来复核改成已完成的推翻；cost of new buses凭空替换主题；has measured ... coming winter把尚未来到的时期说成已取得观测结果。

subject.target: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q: 需要写一句仍适用的票务规则：“发车时间可能调整。”这里只说明可能性，不报告已经执行的处理。哪句准确？
o: Departure times were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday.
Departure times are subject to change.
Departure times are subjected to a detailed inspection every morning.
Departure times are immune to change.

exp.trans: Departure times are subject to change：发车时间可能发生调整。
exp.structure: Departure times（主语）+ are（系动词）+ subject to change（表语）。这里是规则或可能状态，不是在叙述谁已经对时刻表做了什么处理。
exp.other: departure 出发；adjustment 调整；inspection 检查；be immune to 不受……影响。
exp.meaning: be subject to在这条规则中表示可能受变化影响。be subjected to通常强调某对象被施加了某个过程。
exp.rest: were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday：报告昨天实际经历了反复调整，时态和事件性质均不符。are subjected to a detailed inspection：说每天被施加检查过程，inspection也不是时间可能调整。are immune to change：表示不受变化影响，与题意相反。

subject.target: subject A to B / be subjected to
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q:
The cleaner deliberately subjected the curtains to a steam treatment yesterday.
要保留“昨天实际施加了处理”的含义，哪句被动改写准确？
o: The curtains are subject to changes in fashion.
The curtains were exempt from treatment yesterday.
The curtains were subjected to steam yesterday.
The curtains are suitable for steam treatment.

exp.trans: 清洁人员昨天特意对窗帘做了蒸汽处理。选项中的被动改写为：窗帘昨天受了蒸汽处理。
exp.structure: 原主干The cleaner + subjected + the curtains + to a steam treatment。被动改写将the curtains作主语，were subjected是一般过去时被动谓语，to steam说明处理内容，yesterday保留时间；施事已经明确时可省略by the cleaner。这里不是系表结构。
exp.other: cleaner 清洁人员；curtain 窗帘；deliberately 特意地；steam treatment 蒸汽处理。
exp.meaning: were subjected to steam表示窗帘昨天实际经历了蒸汽处理；关键是事件性的被动谓语，不是可能受影响或适合处理的状态。
exp.rest: are subject to changes in fashion：说窗帘可能受时尚变化影响，不是昨天被处理的事件。were exempt from treatment：免于处理，与原文相反。are suitable for steam treatment：适合做处理，只表示适宜性，不能证明处理发生过。

subject.target: be subject to / 实际事件
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q: The mountain road is subject to closure during heavy snow. No closure has been announced today. Which report preserves both statements?
o: The road is reported closed after today's heavy snowfall.
Snow may close the road; no closure is reported today.
The road underwent a test involving closure earlier today.
The road is open because snow cannot lead to its closure.

exp.trans: 这条山路在大雪期间可能封闭。今天尚未宣布封路。准确报道是：大雪可能带来封路，但这两句没有报道今天已经封路。
exp.structure: The mountain road是主语，is是系动词，subject to closure表达所受约束或可能状态。第二句No closure是主语，has been announced是现在完成时被动谓语；没有公告不等于已验证现场一定开放。
exp.other: mountain road 山路；closure 封闭；announce 宣布；status 状态。
exp.meaning: be subject to可表示有可能受某变化影响，不自动表示该事件已经发生。这里也不能从“尚无公告”推出现场已确认开放。
exp.rest: 原文只报告可能受封闭影响，没有报告今天已封路；封路测试是虚构事件；未公布封路不等于已确认开放，更不能说大雪不会造成封路。

example-claim-scope.target: 例子与论点的对应范围
example-claim-scope.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
example-claim-scope.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It measures a shift in members' views on conservation.
It shows why government funds were needed for the trial.
It explains how the new system reduced water consumption.
It illustrates how local groups can help launch a policy.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 没有成员前后态度的测量，不能证明观点转变；材料没有交代政府资金；也没有比较节水系统的技术效果。合作社组织志愿者和动员试用，支持的是政策启动机制。

example-claim-scope.skill: 识别反例对充分条件的限制而非扩大成全面否定
example-claim-scope.q: A consultant argues that longer opening hours are enough to widen access to museums. A writer responds with a neighbourhood museum that stayed open until 10 p.m., yet attracted few additional night-shift workers. Interviews revealed that the last bus serving their workplaces left at 8 p.m. Why does the writer include this case?
o: To show that transport constraints can limit what extended hours achieve.
To identify reduced bus services as a consequence of the later museum hours.
To compare tourists' reasons for visiting with those of local residents.
To present later opening as a substitute for improving transport links.

exp.trans: 顾问认为，只要延长开放时间，就足以让更多人有机会参观博物馆。作者回应说，一家社区博物馆开放到晚上十点，却几乎没有多吸引夜班工人。访谈发现，途经他们工作地点的末班公交在晚上八点就开走了。作者为何举这个例子？为了说明交通限制会影响延长开放时间的实际效果。
exp.structure: A consultant + argues + that从句提出待检验的充分条件；A writer + responds with + a museum引出反例。that stayed open...为修饰museum的定语从句；yet转向预期未实现的结果；Interviews + revealed + that从句提供限制条件。
exp.other: widen access 扩大参与机会；neighbourhood 社区；night-shift worker 夜班工人；extended hours 延长的开放时间；transport link 交通连接。
exp.meaning: 例子针对的是延长开放时间是否单独就足够。公交仍是障碍，说明措施的效果受另一条件限制；没有证明延时开放普遍无效，也没有比较不同群体的喜好。
exp.rest: 末班车时间是已有约束，文中没有说公交服务因博物馆延时而削减；游客与本地居民的参观动机没有被比较；例子指出仅延时仍不足，不能反说延时可以替代交通改善。

example-claim-scope.skill: 把实例放回可见记录与实际行为的区分
example-claim-scope.q: An essay distinguishes a visible change in records from a change in underlying behaviour. It describes a factory where reported near-misses increased after a safety bonus was introduced. An anonymous survey found no change in how often hazards occurred; workers said they had previously kept quiet about them. What does the case illustrate?
o: The bonus increased hazards along with reports of near-misses.
Official incident totals are more reliable than the survey.
Anonymity motivated workers more than the safety bonus did.
Reporting changes can raise counts without raising hazards.

exp.trans: 文章区分记录上的可见变化与实际行为的变化。文中举例，一家工厂引入安全奖励后，上报的险情增多。匿名调查发现，危险出现的频率并没有变化；工人说自己以前对这些情况保持沉默。这个例子说明，记录数量上升可能源自上报方式改变，而不意味着危险同步增加。
exp.structure: An essay + distinguishes + A from B提出上层区分；It + describes + a factory引出例子，where从句补充上报数量变化。was introduced是被动谓语。An anonymous survey + found + no change；how often hazards occurred补充频率。had previously kept quiet指出早期漏报背景。
exp.other: near-miss 险些发生的事故、险情；underlying 实际的、深层的；anonymous 匿名的；hazard 危险因素；incident total 事件总数。
exp.meaning: 实例在支持记录变化不等于实际事件变化这一论点。新增上报与此前沉默形成对照，不能把记录增多直接推成工作更危险；也不应把例证题改答成未讨论的奖励与匿名措施孰强。
exp.rest: 调查显示危险发生频率未变，不能断言奖励增加危险；材料没有给两种数据排可靠性名次；匿名是调查方式，不能据此比较匿名与奖金的激励强度。

example-claim-scope.skill: 区分记录数量变化与真实风险变化
example-claim-scope.q: After a factory introduced anonymous reporting, recorded safety events rose. Independent inspections found no increase in hazards. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The factory became more dangerous after anonymous reporting was introduced.
The rise in reports proves workers deliberately exaggerated safety incidents.
The higher event count may reflect reporting changes rather than more hazards.
Independent inspections confirmed that hazards increased throughout the factory.

exp.trans: 工厂引入匿名报告后，记录到的安全事件增加了，但独立检查没有发现危险因素增加。最有根据的结论是：记录数量的上升可能来自报告方式的变化，而非真实危险增加。
exp.structure: After引导时间背景；recorded safety events rose描述记录数；Independent inspections found no increase in hazards提供独立证据，限制了对真实风险的推断。
exp.other: anonymous reporting 匿名报告；recorded event 记录到的事件；independent inspection 独立检查；hazard 危险因素。
exp.meaning: 报告数量是观测到的数据，可能受报告机制影响；不能直接把记录数增加等同于真实危险增加。
exp.rest: 直接断言工厂更危险，与独立检查结果不符；把报告增加归因于故意夸大，原文没有动机证据；把检查结果说反了。

example-claim-scope.skill: 区分报告数量变化与真实问题变化
example-claim-scope.q: A clinic switched to an online incident form, after which recorded reports rose. External audits found no increase in underlying faults. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The underlying fault rate rose because the clinic changed its form.
More recorded incidents may reflect easier reporting, not more faults.
External audits proved the old reporting system had been accurate.
The clinic changed the form after a separate review found fewer faults.

exp.trans: 诊所改用在线事件表单后，记录的报告增加了，但外部审计没有发现实际故障增加。记录数量的上升可能来自报告更容易，而不是故障变多。
exp.structure: A clinic switched...描述制度变化；after which引出其后的记录变化；External audits found...提供独立证据，限制对真实故障率的推断。
exp.other: incident form 事件报告表；recorded report 记录的报告；external audit 外部审计；underlying fault 实际故障。
exp.meaning: 观测到的报告数会受到报告渠道影响。记录数增加不能单独证明实际问题变多。
exp.rest: 表单变化本身不能证明故障率上升；审计没有证明旧系统完全准确；文中没有说改表单之前另一次审查发现故障减少。
